strategicAlignment.description: Aligns plan with organizational goals and measurable indicators.
requirements: Align departmental objectives and KPIs with strategy.
Identify and track Key Success Indicators (KSIs).

stakeholders.description: Involves key internal and external parties.
requirements: Define roles and responsibilities (use RACI matrix).

scope.description: Defines the boundaries and constraints of the plan.
requirements: Clearly define what is in and out of scope.

resources.description: Identifies the resources required for plan execution.

riskAndMitigation.description: Manages risks and defines contingency strategies.
requirements: Identify potential risks (delays, resource gaps, etc.).

monitoringAndReporting.description: Ensures progress tracking and feedback mechanisms.
requirements: Select progress tracking tools (dashboards, KPIs, reports).
Define a review schedule (e.g., weekly, monthly).

functional.description: Defines core system features and actions.
requirements: Integration with external systems (e.g., HRIS, ERP, CRM).

nonFunctional.description: Specifies how the system performs and behaves.

user.description: Focuses on user needs and interaction design.
requirements: Define user personas and their needs.
Document use cases and user journeys.

data.description: Manages data flow, security, and compliance.
requirements: Define data inputs, outputs, and storage needs.
Plan for data backup and recovery.

technical.description: Defines the technical stack and architecture.
requirements: Define API protocols and integration standards.

planningDesignChecklist.description: Risk management, data protection, escalation paths.
QA strategy, test cases, user acceptance testing.
